# define Shell Script Libraries

Organise the shell code as libraries in the sense of [BashSupport Pro's "libraries"](https://www.bashsupport.com/manual/navigation/libraries/): directories of sourceable files that the IDE (and the reader) can resolve `source` statements against, so that functions have a home file, navigation works, and the rc files only load libraries.
